Adverse Effects and Precautions Hypersensitivity reactions may occur immediately or a few min- utes after injection of patent blue V; on rare occasions they may be severe and include shock, dyspnoea, laryngeal spasm, and oedema. Nausea, hypotension, and tremor have been reported. Giving a small dose to test for hypersensitivity has been suggest- ed. Hypersensitivity.
